verdict.rationale: Kit supports scheduling one-off broadcasts (kit-docs-1) and offers 'Unlimited Visual Automations' and RSS campaigns which inherently recur (kit-docs-6, kit-docs-13), and its MCP server can read/write to a creator's account (kit-docs-20, kit-docs-29), implying an AI agent could trigger these. However, there's no direct evidence that visual automations or recurring workflows are exposed via the API/MCP for AI-native creation or scheduling of recurring jobs—only single-broadcast scheduling is documented. Missing for 10: explicit API/MCP endpoints for creating or managing recurring automations/workflows, documentation of cron-like scheduling for AI agents.
